name: 患者目線・1日Vlog

firstStage: current clinic LP/official homepage or user-confirmed clinic facts
input.missingLpAction: Ask for current clinic LP or facts to adapt the screen-text draft, but do not require patient footage.

flow: Prepare a short screen-text script and shot plan from current LP/confirmed facts. Keep the Vlog structure and reference typography but distinguish current facts from a fictional scenario.

Mark every shot as supplied therapist/clinic, assistant-sourced patient-role, optional verified clinic screen, or missing. Show this script/plan first for confirmation; do not require patient footage or AI voice.
After confirmation, receive therapist/clinic material and prepare only the missing patient-role shots. Honor already approved plan and generation budget; do not repeatedly re-ask settled questions.
Use one fictional person throughout each film. Choose another person for the next separate film; use a per-project visual anchor and available recent cast history, not memory claims.

Edit supplied real material and the approved fictional patient-role story in the agreed order. Use productionDefaults for editable type, bands, clock and closing banner; persistent AI/sample labels are empty by default.

Verify cast continuity, fictional-story attribution, current clinic facts, approved captions/spacing, action completion, audio event sync and final composite. Report native render/export checks separately from independent-operator execution.

patientRole.default: assistant prepares fictional illustrative patient-role shots; the user need not supply patient footage
patientRole.acrossProjectsPolicy: Check accessible recent-cast records and avoid reusing prior character anchors. Do not promise universal global uniqueness or access to others' private projects. If no history exists, create a new project cast and say history was unavailable.
patientRole.anchorPolicy: Save approved identity reference and appearance/outfit notes per project. Reuse the same visual anchor for related shots; text-only matching is not identity verification. A new paid anchor requires the same cost/scope authorization as generation.
castRecordFields: job or licensed stock asset IDs
patientRole.stockUse: Only licensed footage allowing this use and context, preferably a same-actor series with continuity. Verify attribution, model release/context restrictions and actual license terms. Do not imply the model has a diagnosed condition or is a real customer.
patientRole.generatedTreatment: Do not fabricate that a real therapist treated the fictional patient. Prefer supplied hands/therapist demonstration or separate clearly illustrated scene; do not composite a real provider with a fictional patient and present it as documentary treatment.
patientRole.generationScope: After shot plan and cast are concrete, use the active host generation skill and current supported tools. Disclose costs/credits and obtain any missing spend authorization before paid work. If no credits/budget are allowed, use permitted supplied/licensed material or report the exact missing scenes; never silently charge.
patientRole.generatedLabelPolicy: The approved presentation has no persistent AI-generated corner label. Keep fictional provenance in the project record and initial script; do not represent the character as a verified actual customer. Honor explicit current-job labeling requirements and licensed-material requirements.

editing.timing: Use approved screen script and current footage lengths. Keep enough reading time; do not stretch/truncate a character or action to fit61.37seconds.
editing.footageSelection: Keep the supplied therapist recognizable and real clinic information accurate. Never fill missing therapist shots with another clinic's real person.

audio.handling: Current user-authorized reference BGM and SFX, when the source is accessible and permitted for this job. Record scope; do not assume a prior single-ad permission authorizes every future user or redistribution. If the authorized original is unavailable, use provided or commercial-use-permitted free similar sound, state the difference, and do not silently add paid generation or a new subscription. Honor current explicit silence/no-BGM instructions.

helperCompatibility.reason: Dedicated script/shot/cast preparation route with independently editable overlays and generated/stock provenance, not generic fixed-caption timing.

referenceObservationScope: reference, graphicStyle and referenceScriptOnly preserve0.9.0 source observations. productionDefaults are the approved new-production settings and take precedence for new editing.

referenceRegistrationAudio.handling: Use current user-authorized sound. Do not extract the reference soundtrack as a new licensed BGM or invent speech from ASR hallucinations. No new paid audio work implied by patient video generation.

productionDefaults.basis: User-approved production recreation; not identification of original template font/settings. Original reference observations remain unchanged.
productionDefaults.scaling: For the same aspect ratio, multiply every pixel dimension including font, line height, tracking, shadow, padding and coordinates by outputWidth/1080. For another aspect ratio recalibrate the complete composite; do not shrink text to fit copy.

splitSecondBand.layout: Natural flex column; longer first band pushes second down, never overlap.

typography.wrapping: Use intentional Japanese meaning-based line breaks; body captions should normally be at most2 lines and closing clinic information at most3. Split long copy into consecutive cues before reducing the approved size or line height. A08 eight-character-per-line rule does not apply automatically.
typography.increaseNote: Body changed from72 to78px (about8.3%) and line height from78 to104px. Intro and ending were separately adjusted; clock was retained, so this is not a uniform8% scale of every element.

audio.preferredSource: Current user-authorized reference BGM and SFX, when the source is accessible and permitted for this job. Record scope; do not assume a prior single-ad permission authorizes every future user or redistribution.
audio.bgmStyle: Match the reference daily-life Vlog music and phrasing, keep a quiet bed under the text and short accents. Reuse the authorized original before selecting a merely similar track.

mixStartingPoint.scope: Measurements from the approved source. A different source needs loudness matching and listening; do not blindly use the same gain or call these platform loudness standards.

sfxRoles.repeat: If a next-morning waking scene exists, the alarm must also be placed there. The approved film uses two alarms.

audio.sync: Align the audible onset, not merely the file start, to the current scene/text/inset event. The approved example used8 sound placements including2 alarms; use semantic roles, not fixed frame positions/count.
audio.mixedReferenceHandling: If SFX and BGM are mixed, keep a continuous bed and avoid doubling music when layering excerpts. Extracted mixed SFX can retain music residue; do not label them clean isolated stems. Protect starts/tails and fades; check discontinuities and final mix.
audio.fallback: If the authorized original is unavailable, use provided or commercial-use-permitted free similar sound, state the difference, and do not silently add paid generation or a new subscription. Honor current explicit silence/no-BGM instructions.
